title: Failed Machine Recovery Specialist
subtitle: Notices when a GPU worker gets sick or goes silent, then moves its work: to a free local card first, then to the same provider at today's price, then to another provider, and otherwise into a waiting line.
lede: Notices when a GPU worker gets sick or goes silent, then moves its work: to a free local card first, then to the same provider at today's price, then to another provider, and otherwise into a waiting line. For jobs you flag, it pauses and asks you first.
author: Corey James
